# LionPost

> One account for social automation, AI content tools and a creator community. Sixteen tools, free, no card.

## Tools

- [All tools](https://127.0.0.1:44863/tools): the full catalogue with one page per tool
- [Keyword research](https://127.0.0.1:44863/tools/keyword-research): volume, difficulty, intent and trend estimates
- [AEO checker](https://127.0.0.1:44863/tools/aeo-checker): 18 checks for answer engine visibility

## Writing

- [How to run a content queue without becoming a content machine](https://127.0.0.1:44863/blog/how-to-run-a-content-queue-without-becoming-a-content-machine): A weekly ritual for people who publish alone: choose three ideas, write one properly, schedule the rest, and review on Friday.
- [What an answer engine actually reads on your page](https://127.0.0.1:44863/blog/what-an-answer-engine-actually-reads-on-your-page): AI answers quote pages that are easy to quote. Here is the short list of things that decide it, and the fixes that take an afternoon.
- [Sixteen tools, one login: why we bundled instead of unbundled](https://127.0.0.1:44863/blog/sixteen-tools-one-login-why-we-bundled-instead-of-unbundled): Most creator stacks are five subscriptions and four logins. We went the other way, and here is what it cost.
- [The scheduler is the product](https://127.0.0.1:44863/blog/the-scheduler-is-the-product): Anyone can call an API once. The hard part is the third week, when a token expires and nobody is watching.
